description: This file defines interfaces related to eviction strategies and purge management within the Orleans streaming framework, specifically for a pooled queue cache. It includes the IEvictionStrategy interface for eviction behaviors and the IPurgeObservable interface for purge-related actions.

classes.name: IEvictionStrategy
classes.description: Interface for eviction strategies used by the PooledQueueCache, defining methods and properties to perform cache purges and manage purge notifications.

classes.name: IPurgeObservable
classes.description: Interface for objects that can be observed regarding purge operations, providing methods to remove messages and properties to access cache state.

methods.name: PerformPurge
methods.description: Executes a purge operation based on the current UTC time.

methods.name: OnBlockAllocated
methods.description: Notifies that a new block has been allocated for the cache.

methods.name: RemoveOldestMessage
methods.description: Removes the oldest message from the cache.
